decisions.reason: A current-source android draft: the complete supplied Arabic occasion title is readable in natural multiline wrapping, including its ending. No ellipsis, cut glyphs or lost final line is visible in the cited original state image. Current target pixels equal the separately inspected original representative recorded in hidden-finals-image-fingerprints.json where the image was reused.

A current-source android draft: all three current option descriptions, including unavailable options, are fully visible within their respective growing cards in the cited original state frames. The card boundaries do not cut the text; viewport-edge fragments are resolved by the overlapping original capture. Current target pixels equal the separately inspected original representative recorded in hidden-finals-image-fingerprints.json where the image was reused.

A current-source android draft: the complete balance content is stacked in distinct rows; the balance amount and label stay clear of the selected-title, total, prepaid and credit text. The cited original card view and overlapping state sweep show no text overlap. Current target pixels equal the separately inspected original representative recorded in hidden-finals-image-fingerprints.json where the image was reused.
